newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Chlorine bomb explodes at Australian supermarket.
newsitem.headline: Chlorine bomb explodes at Australian supermarket.

text.p: A chlorine gas bomb exploded outside a Sydney supermarket on Friday injuring two people, police said.

The explosion occurred outside the Coles supermarket at Bondi Junction in Sydney's eastern suburbs at around 11.00 a.m. (2400GMT), but emergency service officials said it was not known whether the device was planted or thrown from a passing car.
"A chlorine gas bomb has exloded and we have evacuated a supermarket," a police spokesman told Reuters.
A ambulance official said 11 people had been treated at the scene and two had been taken to St Vincents Hospital.
